open_issues: No scanner is attached to this machine, so src/Wakeel.Desktop/Services/WiaScanner.cs is written from the WIA contract (late-bound COM, wiadef.h property ids) and exercised only through IScanner fakes. Its device list, dpi/colour properties, ADF loop and PNG transfer need one run against real hardware before B3-2 is signed off; every failure path already collapses to «لا ماسح ضوئي» / «لم يكتمل المسح».

The OCR test draws its own page with SkiaSharp, which has no bidi/shaping pass, so a line of Arabic is painted first-letter-leftmost and Tesseract returns it back to front (OcrTestImages.AsRead documents this). The Arabic assertion is therefore 'Arabic letters were read and boxed', not an exact word match; the English line is asserted exactly. Accuracy on real typeset scans is not measurable from a synthetic page.

PDFtoImage's platform annotations trip CA1416 in a library that declares no platform of its own; suppressed at the two call sites in PdfRasterizer with the reason written down, rather than spreading [SupportedOSPlatform] through the reader, the queue and Core's contracts.

documents.ocr_lang carries the reading files' fingerprint appended to the languages (ara+eng/<12 hex chars>) because the schema has no column for it and migrations are not this package's to write. If a column is wanted later, the value is already there to migrate.
notes:
PUBLIC API THE SCREEN PACKAGES CONSUME (all in Wakeel.Core.Services.Documents unless noted).

IDocumentStore (impl VaultStore, Scoped): IsAvailable, Exists, WriteAsync(Stream|ReadOnlyMemory), CopyToAsync, ReadAsync, VerifyAsync, Delete. Answers with VaultState {Ok, Unavailable, Missing, Corrupt} — never an exception — so W46 renders CoreAr.Documents.VaultUnavailable*/FileCorrupt*/FileMissing* straight from the state. Only a caller defect throws (bad hash, no session key). Format: vault\ab\<sha>.bin, per-file HKDF sub key salted with the hash, Aead.EncryptStream in 256 KiB frames, every frame authenticating the hash as associated data, verified twice on read (AEAD tag + SHA-256 of what came out). Static Write/Read/Delete(paths, key, ...) kept for activation, which has no session yet; the UI copy is deleted and ActivationService now uses Core's.

IVaultKeyProvider: the host supplies it. The desktop bridges it to AccountSession (src/Wakeel.Desktop/Services/SessionVaultKeyProvider.cs); the key is fetched per call and the working copy zeroed in a finally, so locking the session really does take it away.

IDocumentService (Scoped): ImportAsync/ImportFileAsync -> DocumentImportResult {State, DocumentId, MessageAr, Sha256Hex}; ScanAsync/PreviewScanAsync/ListScannersAsync; GetAsync, ReadContentAsync, CopyContentToAsync, VerifyAsync; LinkAsync/UnlinkAsync/ListForAsync/ListLinksAsync; SaveDerivedAsync/ListDerivedAsync; SetPinnedOnPhoneAsync/ListPinnedAsync; SetOcrStatusAsync/SavePagesAsync/ListPagesAsync; static SerializeWords/DeserializeWords for document_pages.words. Every refusal carries a finished Arabic sentence, so a screen never composes one.

MEASUREMENTS AND DECISIONS WORTH KNOWING.
- A file is accepted only when its NAME and its first bytes agree (DocumentMediaTypes.FromFileName + Sniff). A renamed executable cannot enter the vault as a .pdf. Limit is exactly 20 MB and 20 MB itself is allowed.
- De-duplication is by hash at BOTH levels: the vault stores one copy, and the document record is reused, so the same attachment on two letters is one document with two links and one OCR run. A derived copy is exempt — it is always its own document.
- The document row is saved BEFORE its link: document_links has an FK to documents and no navigation property, so a single SaveChanges is free to write them in the order SQLite rejects. Two saves also fail in the safe direction.
- Links revive rather than re-insert: the unique index counts soft-deleted rows, so AddLink looks with IgnoreQueryFilters and clears DeletedAt.
- Scanner and PDF binder are OPTIONAL constructor dependencies supplied by hand in AddWakeelCore (the container ignores C# default parameter values). No scanner = the «لا ماسح ضوئي» state, not a failure. No binder = a multi-page scan is stored as separate images rather than lost.
- Multi-page scan -> one PDF via IScanPdfWriter (Wakeel.Ocr/ScanPdfWriter, SkiaSharp SKDocument, sheet pixels mapped to points at 300 dpi so an A4 sheet becomes an A4 page).

OCR (Wakeel.Ocr, registered with AddWakeelOcr()).
- OcrService : IOcrEngine, Singleton. One Tesseract engine built lazily behind a lock (building one costs ~1 s). tessdata found by TessdataLocator in this order: app folder\tessdata, <installation>\models\tessdata, then ..\tools\tessdata walking up 8 levels — which is how the tests find the repo copy. IsAvailable false = «قراءة النصوص غير مهيّأة»; documents are still stored.
- PDF pages rasterised one at a time by PdfRasterizer (PDFtoImage/PDFium, 300 dpi) into PNG bytes and handed to Pix.LoadFromMemory — nothing is ever written to a temporary file, so a confidential scan never leaves the vault. One unrenderable page is skipped, not fatal.
- Word confidence is divided by 100 and clamped: everything in الوكيل stores 0..1. Boxes are OcrWordBox(Text, Confidence, X, Y, Width, Height) in page-image pixels, JSON in document_pages.words — that is what W44 highlights a search hit with.
- OcrQueue : IOcrQueue, Scoped. Order = Interactive before Background, then FIFO within a priority; enqueueing twice does not duplicate but does promote. What is waiting lives in ocr_status, not in a queue file: ResumeAsync flips Running->Pending (a Running row on the way in means a cut-off run) and re-queues every Pending. DrainAsync yields between documents. ReprocessChangedModelAsync marks every Done document whose ocr_lang differs from the files in force.
- ArabicOcrText (in CORE so B3-3 search can share it): Clean (western digits per item 20, invisible marks dropped, layout kept, at most one blank line, no space before Arabic punctuation) and NormalizeForSearch = Clean + ArabicText.Normalize. The search indexer must put its queries through NormalizeForSearch or a query will not match the page text.

SUPERVISOR RULINGS HONOURED.
- CoreAr stays a static partial class; the documents strings are in Services/Documents/CoreAr.Documents.cs. (Its ScanPagesDone called a CoreAr.Plural helper that does not exist — the only compile error the previous attempt left — and now counts the way Arabic counts, inline.)
- ILetterDocumentStore is implemented as LetterDocumentStore over IDocumentService and registered in AddWakeelCore; App.xaml.cs registers IDerivedDocumentBuilder over it, so B3-1b's two unregistered services are now live and the referral print copy of item 31 is actually produced.
- Every numeral in every new sentence is a western digit, asserted in two tests.

TEST TALLY: 1036 total across the three projects (Core 676 incl. 1 pre-existing Word skip, UI 340, Walkthrough 20); 1035 passed, 1 skipped. 108 of the Core tests are this package's. The three tests that need the model files use [OcrFact], which skips with a sentence naming build/get-models.ps1 — they RAN here, because tools/tessdata is present.
